authors_reviews.title: One word- avoid
authors_reviews.text: To be honest I read a lot of reviews before selecting this model. Whatever models I checked in this price range had a few negative reviews with similar complaints- cheap quality, cover doesn't stay, broken/damaged product received etc. Finally chose this because of the Prestige brand and the marking of Amazon's choice. Unfortunately, it was a waste of time.I returned it without using so can't comment about usage experience but this was my experience- first time I opened the box, took out thw spatula and the cover that was placed at the top and immediately decided to order a replacement. They were full of dirt, and looked used.The replacement delivery and pickup of the old package happened at the same time. I opened the new package and then realised the old package also was misaing the user guide cum warranty card! The new package on the other hand looked new but was missing the spatula. Not a big deal for me but the delivery person suggested me to keep the spatula from the old package.I wish I checked the quality of the product first time itself. When I was unpacking the mixer I was surprised how cheap and low quality it can possibly be! But at the end when I lifted the main mixer unit that was the final nail. There was some loose part moving inside it. I've attached a video, not sure if the sound can be heard or not. I called Amazon who suggested to use it and try to see if it is working or not as I had 10 days to return. But after deliberation I decided to return it unused. Even if it worked, a moving part near motor is an accident in the making. I was surprised that in the box someone signed the quality checked ok stamp! If this is OK tested quality from Prestige I'll rather avoid that brand.I read in few reviews people suggesting that companies are making special low quality product to sell online with low price point and standard ones for ofdline sell. I'm starting to believe that and will buy the mixer after physically checking that.However it will be unfair if I don't mention how helpful Amazon was , they actually insisted me to leave a review so that they can adjust their recommendations and can alao take steps against the seller for delivering below par goods.At the end, I noticed one generic problem with every single mixer I checked even in high range products from Philips/Bosch. At least for the chatney jar and some time for all jars they are leaving exposed screws inside the jars. These ridges will accumulate leftover food particles which will be practically impossible to clean and hence this isn't hygienic.
authors_reviews.author: Anupam

authors_reviews.title: No smooth running of the motor
authors_reviews.author: S MAHABOOB BASHA

authors_reviews.title: Okayish deal @2,200
authors_reviews.text: The overall build quality could be better, as the mixer makes quite a lot of noise while running. The product I received also had an issue with the motor mount. The screws were not properly fixed, which caused the joint clip outside the mount to sit at an angle.Fortunately, I noticed the issue early and was able to adjust and fix it myself. However, if left unnoticed, it could potentially damage the mixer jar’s joint connection.I generally have a good opinion of Prestige products, so I’m a little disappointed that this unit seems to have passed the quality check with such an issue. Hopefully, Prestige improves its quality inspection process.That said, at the price point I paid—₹2,200—it still feels like an okayish deal. The product is usable, but the quality control and build could definitely be better.
authors_reviews.author: Rajesh kumar
